acceptance_policy.goal: Complete documented generic capabilities, Euro/China decoding and host contracts using semantic tests and representative integration evidence.
acceptance_policy.checks: Select by changed capability and boundary; reuse applicable unchanged evidence.
acceptance_policy.evidence_invalidation: Only changes to the behavior or delivery boundary covered by evidence invalidate it. Documentation, coverage notes or package-description hashes do not invalidate unrelated runtime, package-consumer or browser results.
acceptance_policy.ci: Automatic code/contract checks use one LTS and the default 22-case matrix. Browser, package, secondary-LTS compatibility and expanded-matrix jobs are independent manual selections. Documentation-only edits do not trigger builds.
acceptance_policy.distribution: Build when dist is needed; publish host assets, synchronize skills/check hashes, and verify independent packages only at the affected delivery boundary or frozen release candidate.
acceptance_policy.historical_audits: Evidence snapshots and optional replay tools, not the current default gates.
acceptance_policy.stop_rule: Close a batch when its preselected necessary checks pass; remaining blockers must name concrete missing behavior or a failure and a bounded closing check. Updating docs or evidence does not restart the chain. Scope-policy revisions close independently when documents, machine policy and default entry points agree; do not reopen all historical audits before the next implementation batch.
acceptance_policy.post_close_rule: Do not reopen the historical 414-case matrix, upstream per-example visual checks or full delivery chain for documentation/evidence updates. Reopen only for a changed affected boundary, a concrete missing required behavior or an actual failure.

historical_acceptance_notes: Independent size/color symbol roles now resolve colliding series IDs across datasets, numeric/category color modes, separate missing statuses, role-aware events/tooltips, matching ranking colors, common size/color domains and offline exports, including independent OD slices. Automatic legends avoid Dorling glyph envelopes. 480 synthetic Chrome source/shape/layout/color cases plus twelve native keyboard/filter/multiples/inset/playback cases and mobile touch are covered under symbol_color_20261109. Full upstream field and example equivalence remains open.

Proportional-symbol positive minRadius, radius-relative offset, spikeWidth and stroke width/opacity now share map, size legend and conservative round-stroke collision geometry. 120 synthetic Chrome source/shape/layout cases verify native bounds, keyboard, Worker and offline exports. Independent color channels and remaining upstream settings are still open; this is not complete field equivalence.
Implementation remains in progress. Unit tests and selected browser probes do not imply full renderer/Euro/China acceptance.
Mobile browser gesture acceptance is not complete.
PNG SVG decoding fallback is covered by raster.test.js.
43 synthetic Chrome cards cover new flow/color/texture and layer legend scenes; legend and region keyboard actions and story controls passed. Narrow screenshot remains a smoke check.
External bundle bytes are authoritative: sidecar resource objects cannot replace hashed JSON; cancellation and reference mismatches tested.
Euro adapter now supports sparse JSON-stat and TopoJSON; unit-specific metadata retained; unknown aggregation defaults to none.
Mercator orientation and projected fit corrected; custom projection registry is application-owned and unknown names fail.

Latest browser probe now covers 46 cards, categorical exceptions, small multiple pagination and real narrow-width resize. An SVG inline baseline feedback loop found by ResizeObserver acceptance was corrected with a block root SVG; touch gestures remain unverified.

Small-multiple domains now include bivariate axes, alpha opacity, proportional/mushroom size, composition/radar totals, bar width/height, time-series axes, and flow/node sizes. Bar is restricted to the base role.

Resolved scheme export freezes current breaks, scalar/composition/opacity/time/flow domains and ternary centers. Raw exportSpec remains available. CSV carries original values, evidence, units, scope, source flags and resource identities with duplicate-region removal.
Spec/data/bundle mutation now previews rendering semantics before commit, including category/number mismatches and negative size failures; failed updates retain current spec, data and output.

414 synthetic source/layout/mode cases now pass Node and Chrome functional baseline checks, standalone SVG/PNG decoding and resolved-spec reopening. Native keyboard and touch cover nine source/layout pairs on choropleth; category and OD data are explicit canonical extensions. This does not close Dorling/dense/assistive technology or the full upstream visual matrix.

Dorling now measures glyph envelopes in pixels through shared renderer models, unions layers, preserves encoded sizes, bounds placement and reports unresolved collisions/overflow. 135 historical Chrome source/mode cases and native keyboard/touch/inset selection pass; custom closed path extrema now also drive collision radii, with current evidence under custom_paths_20261109. This does not guarantee collision-free labels or inter-node flow routes. Worker failures and stale/cancelled replies are covered.

Specialized bivariate, ternary, alpha, time, size/mushroom and flow legends now share content-driven measurement and rendering; complete labels wrap, numerical marks retain scale, and automatic panels avoid titles, footers, ranking, insets and fixed later legends. Overflow/collision is diagnosed. Chrome acceptance covers 30 source/configuration cases at desktop/narrow widths plus keyboard/touch filtering and RTL bounds; custom closed path/viewBox mismatch now uses actual analytic path bounds in the shared size legend layout; current evidence is under custom_paths_20261109.

Rankings now use measured complete text/number/bar layouts, corner placement and declarative formatting; automatic large-region distributions retain original rows and exact bin membership, and independent HTML rankings offer bounded pages and mode controls. Chosen period/series SVG events retain original ranking observations; complete upstream country-group preset mapping and visual acceptance remain open.
acceptance_notes: Current scope and completion rules are defined by ACCEPTANCE.md and acceptance_policy. Generic functionality, numeric semantics, provenance and committed host compatibility remain required.
Default integration uses 22 representative cases. Mode algorithms are covered in focused tests, source protocols in adapter contracts, browser-only behavior in small relevant samples.
No upstream per-example visual equivalence, all-field facade compatibility, exhaustive source/renderer/layout combinations or automatic replay of all historical release gates is required.
Only concrete missing committed behavior or actual defects block capability completion; optional_checks and compatibility_notes do not.
Historical evidence remains valid only where the covered implementation and boundary are unchanged; results for changed behavior require relevant revalidation.

Composition total-size graphical references are verified under composition_legend_20261109 using five source-import browser cases and focused semantic tests. Historical notes describing this gap are superseded for V07/V13/X03. The per-change distribution chain was not rerun.
